title: Why Biting Your Tongue Hurts So Much
caption:
Why does biting your tongue hurt SO bad?
A guy happily devours a burger, then chomps down on his own tongue, and a red HIGH NERVE DENSITY ZONE map of the tongue lights up on screen.
Your tongue is packed with nerve endings, so one wrong bite fires pain signals straight to your brain.
Be honest: how many times have you bitten your tongue this year?
Save this before your next meal and chew with care.
